visual_action: Two men in dark suits, seen from the back, stand on a red carpet on the White House grounds, looking up at the sky. The Washington Monument is visible in the distance. Several fighter jets fly overhead in formation against a clear blue sky. The camera pans up to follow the jets. The video concludes with a black-and-white closing card featuring an image of the White House and then a helicopter, with the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.
